principles: Use a plain-language state label with a concrete next action.
Never imply server confirmation from a local save, network submission, forecast, provider claim, or model output.
Do not use green/red or iconography as the sole communication of state.
Keep critical terms short enough for translation and read-aloud assistance; validate phrasing with local speakers.
Every critical state must distinguish what happened, what is not yet known, and what the user can do next.

states.headline: Saved on this device
states.body: This record is on this device. It has not reached the service yet.

states.headline: Waiting to send
states.body: Your request is saved. It will be sent when a connection is available.

states.headline: Request received
states.body: The service confirmed that this request was received. A provider has not yet agreed to do the work.

states.headline: Two changes need review
states.body: This device and the service have different versions. Nothing has been silently replaced.

states.headline: This information may be out of date
states.body: Last updated: {as_of_time}. Conditions may have changed since then.

states.headline: The sources disagree
states.body: We cannot confirm which observation is correct. Review the sources before acting.

states.headline: Not enough information to confirm this
states.body: The available information does not support a reliable answer yet.

states.headline: Estimated travel time
states.body: This is a modelled estimate, not a measured trip. Route coverage and conditions may affect it.

states.headline: Travel time is not known
states.body: We do not have a validated route estimate for this trip. Straight-line distance cannot confirm travel time.

states.headline: No available provider found
states.body: Your request is still recorded, but no provider is currently available for this work.

states.headline: The quote needs more detail
states.body: Review the missing price, unit, timing, expiry, travel fee, or work-scope terms before agreeing.

states.headline: This quote has expired
states.body: The terms are no longer available for acceptance. Ask whether the provider can renew them.

states.headline: Booking confirmed
states.body: The provider has confirmed the agreed work and time. The work has not yet been completed.

states.headline: The provider reports the work is complete
states.body: Please review the result. You can accept it, report a problem, or request rework.

states.headline: You accepted the completed work
states.body: Your acceptance has been recorded. You can still view the agreed terms and receipt.

states.headline: Problem reported
states.body: Your concern has been recorded. It has not yet been resolved.

states.headline: Future sharing is turned off
states.body: This system will stop new sharing under this permission. Copies already received by others may need separate handling.

states.headline: You can continue with a person
states.body: You can use a phone call, cooperative, adviser, or another supported channel without losing the request reference.

states.headline: We couldn't confirm whether this went through
states.body: Your request may have reached the service, but we do not have an authoritative response. It has not been confirmed or rejected.
secondary_actions: Check status if an authoritative check is available
